Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 31 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 65 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Neeta - 32 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Manoj: "What lovely weather!"

[Manoj sips red wine.]

Meenakshi: "Let's see."

[Manoj presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Manoj: "Well done!"

[Manoj plays dead to fool his sister.]

Meenakshi: "This is amazing!"

[Manoj takes a selfie with Mother.]

Manoj (laughing): "What next?"

[Manoj orders food on his phone.]

Meenakshi: "I'm ready!"

[Manoj jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Manoj (laughing): "Are you okay?"

[Manoj throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Manoj: "I really enjoyed today."
